text:
A man climbs a ladder.
Which two quantities can be used to calculate the useful power of the man?
A
the weight of the man and the time taken only
B
the weight of the man and the vertical distance moved only
C
the work done by the man and the time taken only
D
the work done by the man and the vertical distance moved only

options.label: A
options.text: the weight of the man and the time taken only

options.label: B
options.text: the weight of the man and the vertical distance moved only

options.label: C
options.text: the work done by the man and the time taken only

options.label: D
options.text: the work done by the man and the vertical distance moved only
